scenes.title: A wreath for Samuel, and Françoise says no
scenes.summary: At the florist's, Andréa orders a wreath for Samuel; Françoise Fabian, Samuel's client, says she won't do Gabor Rajevski's film starting in three weeks, and Andréa loses patience: 'At what age do these whims stop?'

scenes.title: Ten days in, and the lift with Mathias
scenes.summary: Camille, exhausted after ten days, moans to Hervé about having no life and no love life; in the lift Mathias tells her not to say tu to him, and she snaps that even she doesn't know she's his daughter.

scenes.title: Mathias takes Samuel's chair
scenes.summary: Funeral calls pour in; Mathias sits in Samuel's chair, shares out Samuel's clients in a spreadsheet, and gives Andréa 24 hours to save the Fabian film after Arditi leaves.

scenes.title: Dinner at Gabriel's
scenes.summary: Over dinner at his flat Gabriel shows Andréa a photo of his ex Florence, who left because he wanted a child; Andréa says she could imagine having a child with him.

scenes.title: Rebecca cries, and the green shawl
scenes.summary: Camille tells Andréa that the forgotten actress Rebecca Vialle is crying in the corridor; Andréa refuses to see her, then learns Camille sent Françoise a green shawl, which brings bad luck to actresses.

scenes.title: Lunch with Line Renaud
scenes.summary: Gabriel lunches with Samuel's old friend and client Line Renaud, who isn't the melancholy kind and asks about the rumours from Rio.

scenes.title: Photocopies as punishment
scenes.summary: Camille explains the shawl went in the bin; Andréa sends her off to do lots of photocopies.

scenes.title: Hippolyte at the photocopier
scenes.summary: At the jammed photocopier Camille meets Hippolyte Rivière, a charming actor from Andréa's list, who invites her for a coffee; she says he needs an appointment.

scenes.title: Gabriel pitches Gabor's film to Line
scenes.summary: Line wants something powerful and full of life; Gabriel, improvising, offers her Françoise Fabian's part in Gabor Rajevski's elderly Bonnie and Clyde film, and Line likes the sound of it.

scenes.title: The funeral guest lists
scenes.summary: Hervé and Camille juggle the agents' guest lists for the funeral; the producer arrives looking for Andréa.

scenes.title: The producer, and three voicemails
scenes.summary: Producer Emma says Françoise called Andréa odious and Piccoli won't do the film without her; Andréa swears she'll win Françoise back, then makes a mess of three voicemail apologies.

scenes.title: Line Renaud? Are you mad?
scenes.summary: Gabriel proposes Line Renaud to replace Françoise; Andréa finds the idea absurd and calls it another film; he calls her a snob.

scenes.title: Gabriel has doubts
scenes.summary: Gabriel has doubts; Hervé offers carrot juice and tells him to call Line back; Gabriel tells Line he got carried away, the script is very violent, but Line is unbothered and leaves for the Lido. A text calls the partners to an emergency meeting with Hélène Kerr.

scenes.title: Hélène wants to sell
scenes.summary: At the Westin, Samuel's widow Hélène says there's no will: she inherits his shares and wants to sell; Mathias proposes that the four partners buy them, and they argue about money.

scenes.title: A sleepless night online
scenes.summary: Unable to sleep, Andréa checks her bank site, then a dating site; a chat goes badly.

scenes.title: Arlette's life insurance
scenes.summary: At the café, Andréa spent the night doing loan simulations; Arlette says she will put her life insurance into the agency: the agency is all her family.

scenes.title: Line and Françoise: the old story
scenes.summary: Hervé tells Camille why Gabriel's idea is cheeky: Line and Françoise have hated each other since Françoise introduced her boyfriend Samuel to Line, decades ago.

scenes.title: Sofia's favour
scenes.summary: Camille asks Sofia to send photos to a casting director; Gabriel explains why the brunette is among the blondes.

scenes.title: Andréa 'bumps into' Françoise
scenes.summary: Andréa meets Françoise as if by chance, apologises, and lets slip that Gabor is taking Line Renaud; the two women praise Line in very double-edged words, and Françoise starts to want the part back.

scenes.title: I did a Mathias
scenes.summary: Andréa boasts she turned Françoise by lying about Line, the power of rivalry; the film is saved.

scenes.title: Gabor wants Line too
scenes.summary: Line rings: after two hours with Gabor she has the part; Andréa and Gabriel now have two stars for one role and have a furious row.

scenes.title: Hélène says no to Mathias
scenes.summary: Mathias offers Hélène 17% and a buyback within a year; she tells him Samuel cheated on her with actresses, that she hates actresses, and that she'll look at other offers.

scenes.title: Sofia leaves
scenes.summary: Sofia says goodnight.

scenes.title: Hippolyte comes back at night
scenes.summary: Late at night Hippolyte comes for a script, shows Camille how directors frame a shot, and they kiss; nearby Andréa can't concentrate on the tapes of Line and Françoise.

scenes.title: A scooter to the funeral
scenes.summary: The next morning Hippolyte offers Camille a ride to the funeral on his scooter.

scenes.title: Samuel's funeral
scenes.summary: At Père-Lachaise the partners squabble about the two actresses; at the tribute Françoise and Line each give a eulogy for Samuel, and the room sings his song.

scenes.title: Why not both?
scenes.summary: Andréa and Gabriel pitch Gabor and Emma a new idea: cast both women as an elderly female Bonnie and Clyde; Gabor loves it.

scenes.title: Meet the family
scenes.summary: Hippolyte introduces Camille to his mother Catherine and then to his father: Mathias. Camille realises Hippolyte is her half-brother.

scenes.title: What happened last night?
scenes.summary: In a back room Hippolyte wants Camille; she asks what happened last night; he says nothing: she fell asleep in two seconds. She's relieved.

scenes.title: Andréa and Gabriel make up
scenes.summary: Andréa tells Hippolyte there's no part for him; then she and Gabriel apologise to each other, and Gabriel takes back his insult: he won't abandon her when she wants a baby at 40, he'll take her to Holland.

scenes.title: I'm your family too
scenes.summary: Mathias accuses Camille of playing with his son; she calls him a coward who never owned up to them: 'I'm your family too!'. Later Noémie lights her cigarette: sorrows go up in smoke.
